content: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices, when utilized in conjunction with preprandial (before meals) and postprandial (after meals) blood glucose monitoring, can significantly enhance the precision of A1C target refinement. This allows for more accurate adjustments in diabetes management and therapy. For individuals who are unable to use CGM devices on a continuous basis, periodic scans of glucose levels can still offer critical and actionable insights to aid in the effective management of diabetes.
